title: Finite Koszul evaluation identifies the Hom tower and the strict dual tensor tower
statement: Let C be a small category with topology J, O a commutative ring sheaf, r a natural number, and b a Fin r family of global sections. With P the actual positive Koszul diagram and T the strict dual tensor tower of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system], there is for every coefficient complex N an isomorphism of inverse diagrams Hom(P_m,N) ≅ T(N)_m. The isomorphisms commute with coefficient chain maps. After precomposition by P_m -> O[0], inverse evaluation at one followed by the comparison is exactly the specified tensor unit N -> T(N)_m. There is no colimit, ordinary inverse limit, derived category, or injectivity hypothesis in this statement.

source.place: Tag 0A0A, lemma-colim-and-lim-of-duals; Section 0A8X, section-hom-complexes; for finite evaluation also lemma-dual-perfect-complex and more-algebra.tex Tag 0913. Finite evaluation: sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08JJ, lemma-dual-perfect-complex.

proof.text: Each actual positive Koszul stage P_m is dualizable by the bounded two-term factor argument and tensor induction. The canonical tensor evaluation E(P_m,N) is therefore an isomorphism. Source naturality makes these maps a natural isomorphism from the strict dual tensor tower to the Hom tower. Take its inverse to obtain the isomorphism requested in the statement.

Coefficient naturality of E proves the first equation after postcomposing with E(P_m,M) and cancelling the inverse evaluation. For the unit equation, similarly postcompose by E(P_m,N); substitute the actual dual projection and use source naturality for P_m -> O[0]. The tensor-Hom unit identity reduces the composite to u(N) followed by precomposition with that projection. The normalization u(N)=ringedHomUnitEvaluationIso.inv gives the desired equality.

theorem exists_ringedKoszul_finiteEvaluation :
    ∃ e : ∀ N : ringedSiteComplex O,
      (ringedKoszulDiagram O r b).op ⋙ (homComplexFunctor (R := O)).flip.obj N ≅
        (ringedKoszulTensorTower O r b).obj N,
      (∀ (N M : ringedSiteComplex O) (f : N ⟶ M) (m : ℕᵒᵖ),
        ((homComplexFunctor (R := O)).obj
          (op ((ringedKoszulDiagram O r b).obj m.unop))).map f ≫ (e M).hom.app m =
        (e N).hom.app m ≫ ((ringedKoszulTensorTower O r b).map f).app m) ∧
      (∀ (N : ringedSiteComplex O) (m : ℕᵒᵖ),
        (ringedHomUnitEvaluationIso O N).inv ≫
          ((homComplexFunctor (R := O)).map
            (ringedKoszulProjection O r b m.unop).op).app N ≫ (e N).hom.app m =
        ringedKoszulTensorUnitComponent O r b N m)
